entries.014da0c87e3b83d8: A company that makes and sells knotless nets, twisted nets and ropes for fishing and land use, and also handles fishery-related materials and marine products.
entries.2723d6bc2473d98f: Operators of golf driving ranges and sports facilities
entries.351a9ad519e1b7d4: This category is not included in reportable segments and includes the manufacture and maintenance of industrial machinery. Consolidated subsidiary Nihon Turning Co., Ltd. manufactures and repairs machinery equipment such as net-knitting machines and processes machine parts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥2 million.
entries.713e78c760f695a7: The main business manufactures and sells products including knotless fishing nets, knotted fishing nets, twisted nets, gill nets, fiber ropes, aquaculture wire mesh and antifouling agents; it also handles purchased goods such as fishing boats, fishing net accessories, labor-saving fishing machinery and equipment, feed and bait, small fish processing machines, ice-making machines, aquaculture fry and marine products, and provides management guidance including fishing ground guidance for set-net fishing and other fisheries. Net sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥17,785 million. Subsidiaries including Takyu Seimo, Nitto Net, and local subsidiaries in Chile and Thailand handle manufacturing, tailoring and antifouling processing, and the group includes a subsidiary that conducts set-net fishing.
entries.799cbac6398f780f: The company is headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo. The company forms a group with 15 subsidiaries, and consolidated employees as of April 30, 2026 numbered 953. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and the Nagoya Stock Exchange Premier Market.
entries.acd0ca050461eaef: Businesses and local governments engaged in wildlife damage countermeasures
entries.c6f4aa68c95e4eeb: The business handles land-use net products such as knotless nets, knotted nets, insect-proof nets, industrial greenhouse bands and ropes, sells purchased products including agricultural materials, cultivation soil and aluminum frames for insect-proof nets, and designs, constructs and sells land-use nets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥4,315 million. Consolidated subsidiary Taitō Co., Ltd. is responsible for the design, construction, processing and sale of animal damage prevention nets, golf driving range nets and sports nets, among others.
